items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Jimmy Brazier won a contest where the interviewee played, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or memory of Brazier.

ctx.x: Well, I did a couple of tunes at... I played a Fats Waller tune at the assembly, where everybody got together... Jimmy Brazier won the thing, the “Washington and Lee Swing.”
I believe the Fats Waller tune you played was “Hold Tight.”
